Question
========
What is the main goal of data quality management?

Answerlist
----------
* reducing storage costs
* ensuring data are suitable for intended use
* improving accuracy and validity of data
* automating data collection


Solution
========
The main goal of data quality management is ensuring data are suitable for intended use.
